subject: general
question: In which of the following cities was the 33 ft tall bronze statue of Swami Vivekananda inaugurated on National Youth Day in 2019?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ranchi, Jharkhand**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A 33 ft tall bronze statue of **Swami Vivekananda** was inaugurated in **Ranchi, Jharkhand** on National Youth Day in 2019.
 
• The statue was unveiled by the **Chief Minister of Jharkhand**.
 
• National Youth Day is celebrated on **January 12th** each year to honor the birth anniversary of Swami Vivekananda.
 
• Swami Vivekananda is renowned for his teachings on youth empowerment and his contributions to Indian philosophy and spirituality.
 
• The statue stands as a symbol of inspiration for the youth, encouraging them to follow the principles and values espoused by Swami Vivekananda.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Swami Vivekananda was born on **January 12, 1863**, in Kolkata, West Bengal.
 
• He was a key figure in the introduction of Indian philosophies of Vedanta and Yoga to the Western world.
 
• Swami Vivekananda's speech at the **Parliament of the World's Religions** in Chicago in 1893 is highly regarded and remembered.
 
• National Youth Day was declared by the Indian Government in **1984** and has been celebrated annually since **1985**.
 
• His teachings continue to inspire millions of people worldwide, especially the youth, to strive for excellence and self-improvement.
